note: Accept/reject corpus for the profile contract. `accept` entries must validate with zero errors; `reject` maps a fixture to the error text it must produce. Fixtures are synthetic profiles that borrow real provider ids so the id/filename and known-provider rules can be exercised; they are not the published profiles. Add a case here whenever you add a rule to scripts/contract.mjs.

reject.reject/bad-availability.json: "sometimes" is not one of reported | estimated | derived | client_only | not_reported | not_supported
reject.reject/models-without-catalog.json: no model catalog, so actions.models must be "disabled"
reject.reject/usage-without-source.json: usage capability is true, so adapter.usageSource is required
